fullContentHtml:
UP Police Constable Re-Exam Result & Cutoff 2026 — Overview & Official Information

The official result and scorecard for UP Police Constable Re-Exam & Cutoff (2026) have been published by Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB). Candidates who appeared in the examination can check their roll number-wise qualifying status, scorecard, cut-off marks, and merit list on the official portal https://uppbpb.gov.in.

Important Dates Schedule

  • Written Exam Date : Successfully Conducted
  • Provisional Answer Key Release : Published
  • Final Result & Scorecard Declaration : Announced on Official Portal
  • Cut-off Marks & Merit List : Published as Official PDF

Selection Process Stages

  • Step 1: Written Examination Score Evaluation & Normalization
  • Step 2: Category-wise Cut-off Determination
  • Step 3: Document Verification Call for Qualified Candidates

How to Check UP Police Constable Re-Exam Result & Cutoff 2026 & Download Scorecard

  1. Visit the official result portal: https://uppbpb.gov.in.
  2. Click on the "Results" tab on the navigation bar.
  3. Select the notification link for "UP Police Constable Re-Exam & Cutoff Result / Merit List 2026".
  4. Open the published result PDF or enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth on the login screen.
  5. Search for your Roll Number in the merit list using Ctrl + F.
  6. Download and save your marksheet / scorecard for document verification and future rounds.

Important Documents Required for Verification

  • Matriculation (10th) Board Certificate & Marksheet (as proof of Date of Birth and Father's/Mother's name).
  • Intermediate (12th) Marksheet & Passing Certificate (if applicable).
  • Graduation / Diploma / Post-Graduation Degree & Semester-wise Marksheets.
  • Valid Government Photo Identity Card (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID Card / PAN Card / Passport).
  • Category / Caste Certificate (SC / ST / OBC Non-Creamy Layer / EWS) in prescribed Central or State format.
  • Domicile / Residence Certificate issued by the competent revenue authority.
  • Recent color passport-size photographs matching the online application upload.
  • Disability Certificate (PwD) / No Objection Certificate (NOC for serving government employees), if applicable.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q: What is UP Police Constable Re-Exam Result & Cutoff 2026?

UP Police Constable Re-Exam Result & Cutoff 2026 is an official government examination update conducted by Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB). All verified details including dates, eligibility, and direct links are published on this page.

Q: What is the official website for UP Police Constable Re-Exam & Cutoff?

The official examination portal is https://uppbpb.gov.in. Candidates should always verify notices directly from official sources.

Q: What is the selection process for UP Police Constable Re-Exam & Cutoff?

The selection process typically includes a written examination (CBT/OMR), document verification, and medical examination as per official guidelines.

Q: How can candidates download the official notification PDF?

Candidates can download the official notification PDF directly from the Important Links section on this page or through https://uppbpb.gov.in.
